description: Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no. 2 (approved plans) and Condition 4 pursuant to planning permission reference 232383VAR dated 28/07/2023 for "Minor material amendment (S.73) to vary condition no.2 (approved plans), seeking to include the addition of 4 windows to the rear elevation at ground floor level and combine the two units to one unit, in pursuant to planning permission reference 216181FUL dated 15/06/2021 for ''Change of use of the existing ground floor commercial units (Mixed Use Class  A1/A2/B1/D1) into commercial units with flexible use  (Mixed Use Class E(a)/E(c)/E(d)/E(e)/E(g)/F1(a)/F1(b))''. Variation seeks to vary condition 4 related to obscure glazing as the prospective tenant of the commercial unit is a GP practice; vary condition 2 replace the proposed drawings listed in condition 2 with those submitted with this application.
